newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Three Russians shot dead while walking a dog.
newsitem.headline: Three Russians shot dead while walking a dog.

text.p: Three Russians were shot dead as they walked a dog in Moscow early on Saturday, police said.

A duty officer said police had no clues as to why the murderer shot a 36-year-old woman and two men aged 33 and 39 at about 1 a.m. (2100 GMT on Friday) in northern Moscow. The killer and the murder weapon, a pistol, had not been found.
Violent crime has increased in Moscow since the end of communist rule and the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991. Many shootings are carried out by criminal gangs or hired killers.

In a separate incident on Friday, four people were killed when part of a tree fell on them as they strolled through a park in the town of Sukhnichi, about 300 km (190 miles) southeast of Moscow, the Emergencies Ministry said.

It gave no details of the people who died. Itar-Tass news agency said part of the tree was torn off in strong winds as people were out celebrating the 52nd anniversary of the end of World War Two in Europe, a major holiday in Russia.
